voice_156:r_479b340ccc6c572b.text: I'll grant you ease in one blow!

voice_156:r_9fcb3754cb1773c7.text: No lonely hell.\nI'll kill you all!

voice_156:r_f7570547e9f80a64.text: None can stop us now we've awoken!

voice_156:r_0bbe0b4f5364e732.text: This land shall run red with blood!

voice_156:r_5dda5198137cb02a.text: Claiming one planet is child's play!

voice_156:r_83ec59afbecdec14.text: We of Mycenae shall claim Earth!

voice_156:r_e20bfd42ad95a3c9.text: Earth has no need of humankind!

voice_156:r_0f58a8822381e57f.text: You shall have no mercy from me!

voice_156:r_6dbcc507fb61b51d.text: All exists for the sake of Mycenae!

voice_156:r_b42ab697149a7c8a.text: I shall make this land your grave!

voice_156:r_4de4fcf3b440baf4.text: Know the folly of defying a god!

voice_156:r_0121a166c715cdff.text: Go entertain Lord Hades in hell!

voice_156:r_30fad37a42bd3ad3.text: A mere human dares confront us?!

voice_156:r_80a0b2a84e05d81a.text: For Lord Hades' sake, vanish here!

voice_156:r_4a9ac1dff86506d9.text: Gods and devils will soon war here!

voice_156:r_924516c8de2b5342.text: You are bearers of the Brand...!

voice_156:r_fdeb8162976e72c1.text: You and Zeus shall both be erased!

voice_156:r_0fadb5c26df92b42.text: Humans, stay out of the gods' war!

voice_156:r_6b15af9a0057cdc8.text: Why do you possess Zeus' arm?!

voice_156:r_ac6fe7838e95647b.text: Aid Zeus,\nchild or not, no mercy!

voice_156:r_665f01666859013b.text: The time has come to settle this!

voice_156:r_ddbe581c5ea9183d.text: Steel giant armor won't save you!

voice_156:r_6ff1323b355593e0.text: Ngh...! Could this one truly be...?!

voice_156:r_342044c706a2340f.text: I knew it...!\nAll woes gather here!

voice_156:r_41997412868c48c4.text: Oh? Is fleeing your only weapon?

voice_156:r_9e6cf4f389dae55c.text: How can that tiny body fight me?

voice_156:r_9e0c80ac7e33b459.text: I'll crush you underfoot for fun!

voice_156:r_7432ef43ed3471dc.text: A Gundam exists even in this age?!

voice_156:r_eb7ae28b53dc033c.text: A relic of the Age of Beasts!

voice_156:r_857c4a52ce8df0fd.text: The Age of Water's legacy remains!

voice_156:r_55417493fce1d347.text: The Age of Wind...! Spiral power?!

voice_156:r_7d724dbcc4451e10.text: You! Are you making sport of me?!

voice_156:r_93e25418a203cb8f.text: Yes! Flee in terror all you like!

voice_156:r_8f60f6fc86db3107.text: That ship shall be a giant coffin!

voice_156:r_b1de76a75a253c13.text: Ready to lose that precious ship?!

voice_156:r_128c35bf3e0e394c.text: I see...!\nYou made it all connect!

voice_156:r_5213c17e13b23de0.text: The Age of the Sun...! At last!

voice_156:r_5aeeb4917340c42d.text: Fool! Have you come seeking death?!

voice_156:r_b765659981b6516d.text: You seem eager for an early grave!

voice_156:r_0c427458bc00eb95.text: How foolish to defy the gods!

voice_156:r_774a9ab4d8fd5351.text: You don't know to leave gods alone!

voice_156:r_7d2617c809fead70.text: It's already too late to flee!

voice_156:r_862ef7385bf2abd4.text: This is the price for defying a god!

voice_156:r_001cbec4d9a4283f.text: I grant your courage in facing me!

voice_156:r_8ad40afecd02b41e.text: I shall turn the tables on you!

voice_156:r_26e5efec03c03d78.text: Too late to regret it now!

voice_156:r_4ad81e88c7557a8b.text: Caught you! I awaited this opening!

voice_156:r_f2e18dfdfe0c89ea.text: So! You wish to taste divine power!

voice_156:r_cf7dbf49e96a5755.text: I'll torment you to the bitter end!

voice_156:r_fa96676cc65bb509.text: No games! Crush them in one blow!

voice_156:r_4e37f92e7d2fc62e.text: Too soft! This is how one attacks!

voice_156:r_66ab4cfe1557909d.text: Please leave the rest to me!

voice_156:r_6c13bbfd27a7799e.text: You don't know when to die!

voice_156:r_06f88dcbd3c9e738.text: This is the power of a god!

voice_156:r_45abf84f7757d6eb.text: T-To think I would perish here...!

voice_156:r_edd7a13ab8f06a14.text: I am a god, yet I have lost?!

voice_156:r_8165e5b41f0124c4.text: Gwooh! I-Is this the end for me?!

voice_156:r_eb643f8bf737a0ca.text: Zeus! I'll be waiting in hell!

voice_156:r_9b63cf1f3e0207ef.text: Traitor! How dare you do this to me!

voice_156:r_3701cba361f80ea5.text: Getter Rays are not to be scorned!

voice_156:r_63f429c5c68c0863.text: You merit being called a god!

voice_156:r_98ed411352a3a6ac.text: Their power...! Equal to a god?!

voice_156:r_862b92e63adb9734.text: Ngh! You confound me with speed?!

voice_156:r_cb306ef55e49d107.text: So you truly harbor their power!

voice_156:r_288133bc5b573dae.text: Why?! Why am I being overwhelmed?!

voice_156:r_6f95653e548f8fcf.text: Ngh! To think this could happen...!

voice_156:r_d249d68bada91ab9.text: I fight till my heart beats no more!

voice_156:r_e9b3307e9eb69f11.text: I fight on though this body decays!

voice_156:r_03cdac73042343ee.text: For Mycenae,\nI do not fear death!

voice_156:r_981f8fedd5414fe5.text: My rage has reached its zenith!

voice_156:r_96bb0dcde0c8c44a.text: This rage\nonly your life can quell!

voice_156:r_a0f2074af8debbfa.text: I'll make you regret being born!

voice_156:r_b5f5a97ed82acb0b.text: Human! Why do you not fear us?!

voice_156:r_2b4d8818c77b6dca.text: You are worthy to face a god!

voice_156:r_087354f2db0a31e6.text: You shall learn what true terror is!

voice_156:r_d520c6d5298a848d.text: You're doomed. Come stake your life!

voice_156:r_099e2458cabf796f.text: Did you think that could defeat me?!

voice_156:r_9736f29b11344ec3.text: We of Mycenae do not fear pain!

voice_156:r_fcd05582aa5c6068.text: A mere human laid hands on me...!

voice_156:r_b57d2d74233f889a.text: Nghhh! Is this the power of humans?!

voice_156:r_cd06d0820d82524b.text: Here shall be your place of death!

voice_156:r_c94c6d04be583774.text: You! Don't expect an easy death!

voice_156:r_e54e2c99ef8297af.text: I can no longer let you live!

voice_156:r_f16a3eb0bcaac082.text: I shall repay this wound twofold!

voice_156:r_d907fbd7bc1c4298.text: Is this all the god Zeus can do?!

voice_156:r_a8e85bd950696403.text: I must slay it before it awakens...!

voice_156:r_84883aa95f63ce32.text: So feeble, yet you challenge a god?!

voice_156:r_25493e978ce8ff16.text: What's wrong? Is that your best?!

voice_156:r_7316666150e42960.text: Not even one chance in ten thousand!

voice_156:r_ce1a22dfe3a4d339.text: You call that an attack? Laughable!

voice_156:r_dca67f68a573fab7.text: There is no need to bother dodging!

voice_156:r_6f94566ad37f8ff8.text: So little power before a god?!

voice_156:r_942ca03c9de80143.text: It seems your courage is all talk!

voice_156:r_d8c669c70659e18a.text: Why can't you see it's futile?!

voice_156:r_05ea490d2f522520.text: Fear has left your body frozen!

voice_156:r_2502132569141ea3.text: Learn the folly of opposing a god!

voice_156:r_1ff312798a52c8eb.text: Did you truly think that would hit?!

voice_156:r_fa07d90fca62f593.text: This is child's play for me!

voice_156:r_a25bf2676ecf9d83.text: All your efforts were for nothing!

voice_156:r_237a0288b42dce20.text: Before a god, your power is nothing!

voice_156:r_0556e8a22779ea8e.text: Know that this too is divine power!

voice_156:r_09d377101a48d92a.text: What now?! Not even one scratch?!

voice_156:r_03f6158ef83964f3.text: Hmph! You think you outwitted me?

voice_156:r_be661448b85d0009.text: Do you crave survival that badly?

voice_156:r_958a56c1151cab9e.text: Savor your life while you still can!

voice_156:r_5508a7bfa9074eb9.text: Stay there and tremble in terror!

voice_156:r_09a003e91f0d5dc7.text: How dare you deceive a god!

voice_156:r_192447448ebd7bb5.text: Hmph. Your games go too far!

voice_156:r_207b256d613bb896.text: I cannot let an ally die!

voice_156:r_a6fd676d8146501b.text: This duty is mine to perform!

voice_156:r_94d35e5fa8e3a198.text: Lord Hades need not\ndeal with you!

voice_156:r_b686510e636673f3.text: Know this is the blade of a god!

voice_156:r_59369bad143d4272.text: This blade shall reap your life!

voice_156:r_25f9b1e39dd8d366.text: Test its edge upon your flesh!

voice_156:r_09a780acca0eb4b0.text: I shall cleave you clean in two!

voice_156:r_af62f2ee466b5c8c.text: I shall carve you to ribbons!

voice_156:r_20cfb719db02fafd.text: This scythe severs even the soul!

voice_156:r_23f0d87a5a6cfca1.text: Behold the edge of hell's scythe!

voice_156:r_60c94ea4eb7f7404.text: I am a god, and your Grim Reaper!

voice_156:r_727b2ee0277f9159.text: A hell scythe gifted by Lord Hades!

voice_156:r_96d39b8bdfa6f183.text: I shall twist you into nothing!

voice_156:r_0e4f9b8a2d26ebff.text: Taste the mighty strength of a god!

voice_156:r_79e0d542fe12bcf7.text: This is a god's mighty strength!

voice_156:r_eff747ba39a55393.text: Fwahahaha! You can no longer escape!
